label: TP
reason: User-controlled cookie value flows through decode -> Base64 encode/decode roundtrip -> becomes fileName which is used in Files.newInputStream() AND printed via ESAPI encoder. The Base64 roundtrip does not sanitize against XSS - it preserves HTML special characters while maintaining obfuscation capability. User input reaching the file read operation combined with potential reflection in output constitutes a genuine XSS risk.
